record.bible_text: The burden<WH04853> which Habakkuk<WH02265> the prophet<WH05030> did see<WH02372><WTH8804>.

O LORD<WH03068>, how long shall I cry<WH07768><WTH8765>, and thou wilt not hear<WH08085><WTH8799>! <FI>even<Fi> cry out<WH02199><WTH8799> unto thee <FI>of<Fi> violence<WH02555>, and thou wilt not save<WH03467><WTH8686>!

Why dost thou shew<WH07200><WTH8686> me iniquity<WH0205>, and cause <FI>me<Fi> to behold<WH05027><WTH8686> grievance<WH05999>? for spoiling<WH07701> and violence<WH02555> <FI>are<Fi> before me: and there are <FI>that<Fi> raise up<WH05375><WTH8799> strife<WH07379> and contention<WH04066>.

Therefore the law<WH08451> is slacked<WH06313><WTH8799>, and judgment<WH04941> doth never<WH05331> go forth<WH03318><WTH8799>: for the wicked<WH07563> doth compass<WH03803><WTH8688> about the righteous<WH06662>; therefore wrong<WH06127><WTH8794> judgment<WH04941> proceedeth<WH03318><WTH8799>. <RF>wrong: or, wrested<Rf><CM>

Behold<WH07200><WTH8798> ye among the heathen<WH01471>, and regard<WH05027><WTH8685>, and wonder<WH08539><WTH8690> marvellously<WH08539><WTH8798>: for <FI>I<Fi> will work<WH06466><WTH8802> a work<WH06467> in your days<WH03117>, <FI>which<Fi> ye will not believe<WH0539><WTH8686>, though it be told<WH05608><WTH8792> <FI>you<Fi> .

For, lo, I raise up<WH06965><WTH8688> the Chaldeans<WH03778>, <FI>that<Fi> bitter<WH04751> and hasty<WH04116><WTH8737> nation<WH01471>, which shall march<WH01980><WTH8802> through the breadth<WH04800> of the land<WH0776>, to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> the dwellingplaces<WH04908> <FI>that are<Fi> not theirs. <RF>breadth: Heb. breadths<Rf>

They <FI>are<Fi> terrible<WH0366> and dreadful<WH03372><WTH8737>: their judgment<WH04941> and their dignity<WH07613> shall proceed<WH03318><WTH8799> of themselves. <RF>their judgment...: or, from them shall proceed the judgment of these, and the captivity of these<Rf>

Their horses<WH05483> also are swifter<WH07043><WTH8804> than the leopards<WH05246>, and are more fierce<WH02300><WTH8804> than the evening<WH06153> wolves<WH02061>: and their horsemen<WH06571> shall spread<WH06335><WTH8804> themselves, and their horsemen<WH06571> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> from far<WH07350>; they shall fly<WH05774><WTH8799> as the eagle<WH05404> <FI>that<Fi> hasteth<WH02363><WTH8804> to eat<WH0398><WTH8800>. <RF>fierce: Heb. sharp<Rf>

They shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> all for violence<WH02555>: their faces<WH06440> shall sup up<WH04041> <FI>as<Fi> the east wind<WH06921>, and they shall gather<WH0622><WTH8799> the captivity<WH07628> as the sand<WH02344>. <RF>their...: or, the supping up of their faces, etc: or, their faces shall look (Heb. the opposition of their faces) toward the east<Rf>

And they shall scoff<WH07046><WTH8691> at the kings<WH04428>, and the princes<WH07336><WTH8802> shall be a scorn<WH04890> unto them: they shall deride<WH07832><WTH8799> every strong hold<WH04013>; for they shall heap<WH06651><WTH8799> dust<WH06083>, and take<WH03920><WTH8799> it.

Then shall <FI>his<Fi> mind<WH07307> change<WH02498><WTH8804>, and he shall pass over<WH05674><WTH8799>, and offend<WH0816><WTH8804>, <FI>imputing<Fi> this<WH02098> his power<WH03581> unto his god<WH0433>.<CM>

<FI> Art<Fi> thou not from everlasting<WH06924>, O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, mine Holy One<WH06918>? we shall not die<WH04191><WTH8799>. O LORD<WH03068>, thou hast ordained<WH07760><WTH8804> them for judgment<WH04941>; and, O mighty God<WH06697>, thou hast established<WH03245><WTH8804> them for correction<WH03198><WTH8687>. <RF>mighty...: Heb. rock<Rf> <RF>established: Heb. founded<Rf>

<FI> Thou art<Fi> of purer<WH02889> eyes<WH05869> than to behold<WH07200><WTH8800> evil<WH07451>, and canst<WH03201><WTH8799> not look<WH05027><WTH8687> on iniquity<WH05999>: wherefore lookest<WH05027><WTH8686> thou upon them that deal treacherously<WH0898><WTH8802>, <FI>and<Fi> holdest thy tongue<WH02790><WTH8686> when the wicked<WH07563> devoureth<WH01104><WTH8763> <FI>the man that is<Fi> more righteous<WH06662> than he? <RF>iniquity: or, grievance<Rf>

And makest<WH06213><WTH8799> men<WH0120> as the fishes<WH01709> of the sea<WH03220>, as the creeping things<WH07431>, <FI>that have<Fi> no ruler<WH04910><WTH8802> over them? <RF>creeping: or, moving<Rf>

They take up<WH05927><WTH8689> all of them with the angle<WH02443>, they catch<WH01641><WTH8799> them in their net<WH02764>, and gather<WH0622><WTH8799> them in their drag<WH04365>: therefore they rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> and are glad<WH01523><WTH8799>. <RF>drag: or, flue net<Rf>

Therefore they sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8762> unto their net<WH02764>, and burn incense<WH06999><WTH8762> unto their drag<WH04365>; because by them<WH01992> their portion<WH02506> <FI>is<Fi> fat<WH08082>, and their meat<WH03978> plenteous<WH01277>. <RF>plenteous: or, dainty: Heb. fat<Rf>
Shall they therefore empty<WH07324><WTH8686> their net<WH02764>, and not spare<WH02550><WTH8799> continually<WH08548> to slay<WH02026><WTH8800> the nations<WH01471>?<CM>
